question_pt: Como a tabela de staging se distribui por carater de internacao?
sql: SELECT c.DESCRICAO AS carater, COUNT(*) AS registros_staging FROM _staging_internacoes s JOIN car_int c ON s.CAR_INT = c.CAR_INT GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY registros_staging DESC
